newsitem.title: UK: LIFFE wheat down, old crop hits new low.
newsitem.headline: LIFFE wheat down, old crop hits new low.

text.p: LIFFE wheat contracts fell, with a new low made on the old crop, traders said.
July came down to 85.50 stg, a new contract low, but enough buyers were enticed back into the market to get it back up to 86.20 stg, 1.30 stg down.

Traders said the fall was due to long liquidation, on continued sentiment that there is "still a lot of wheat about," as one put it. Exports to other-EU countries could come to the aid of the old crop market, he said, "if we remain competitive.
The new crop came down on shipper selling, he said. November last traded 0.85 stg lower at 92.15 stg.
November was most active, with 350 lots done, followed by 213 lots on January. Total wheat volume was 859 lots.
There were 27 lots done on barley, with 13 lots to make November most active. It last traded 0.50 stg lower at 90.00 stg.
